rows.Synonyms:
• Count Dracula
• DELparfrou
• Republic de Montmartre
rows.ARS:
Medium red Shrub.
Exhibition name: Republic de Montmartre
rows.Origin:
Bred by G. Delbard (France, 2011).
Introduced in France by Delbard/Georges Delbard SA in 2012 as 'République de Montmartre'.
rows.Bloom: Red. Mild, raspberry fragrance. up to 100 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, very full (41+ petals), cluster-flowered, cupped, old-fashioned bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Glossy foliage.

Height: 31" to 39" (80 to 100cm). Width: up to 20" (up to 50cm).
